patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s high-performing RY–CZ–RZ–CZ brick-ring structure while adopting parameter sharing from the more efficient inspiration. The eight independent RZ angles are replaced by two staggered phase parameters shared across even and odd wires. This preserves symmetry-aware phase flexibility beyond a single collective angle while reducing the block from 16 to 10 parameters, lowering the total from 98 to 62 parameters. The full CZ ring, independent RY mixing, circuit depth, and fixed training pipeline remain unchanged.
